badge_testo: APP BIODIVERSA · CASE STUDY · PRODUCT · UX ·
contesto_lead: and explains it to the people
contesto_body: App Biodiversa collects environmental data from sensors and field observations and delivers it to companies and communities. The value was there: solid science, plenty of data.
The problem was the bridge between the two worlds: the people using the app weren’t scientists, and the numbers — on their own — didn’t say what to do.
sfida_statement: Translating complex scientific data into *decisions anyone can make.*
sfida_body: Every user arrived with a different question and a different level of expertise. We had to understand who was really in front of the product, what they were looking for, and redesign the experience around their decisions — not around the available data.

ruolo_attivita.descrizione: Interviews and usage analysis to understand who opens the app, with which question, and where they get lost.
Redesign of the key flows: from charts to actions, in a language readable by non-scientists.
Priorities and release sequence: what to build first, what next, and why — shared with the development team.

strategia_paragrafo: We flipped the app’s hierarchy: no longer data up front with actions to hunt for, but actions up front with data as support. Every screen answers a user question, not a database table. The roadmap gave the team a sustainable build order, tied to the value for the people using the app.
cosa_dimostra: The value of a data-driven product isn’t in the amount of data, but in the quality of the decisions it enables: UX is strategy, not decoration.

seo.title: App Biodiversa — Case study · Valentina Inchingolo
seo.description: Discovery, UX and roadmap for App Biodiversa: scientific biodiversity data translated into concrete actions for the people using the product.
